architecture: 5-fold XGBoost ensemble stacked through a meta-model (meta_model.joblib) that calibrates the fold-averaged raw score into a probability
feature_cols: esm2_0..esm2_639 (mean-pooled ESM2 embedding) followed by 21 modlAMP global/moment descriptors (modlamp_Length, MW, Charge, ChargeDensity, pI, InstabilityInd, Aromaticity, AliphaticInd, BomanInd, HydrophRatio, eisenberg/gravy/flexibility/aasi global+moment, z3, z5, abhprk); the full ordered list is in the weights-side model_card.json that predictor.py loads

training_data.locked_test: 651 peptides (338 pos / 313 neg) in 539 clusters; zero cluster overlap with train/val
